name: Heart of Gloom

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-11: The Darkness Within

stealth.details: (expert) to detect the fraying planes around it; noticing the Heart has a DC of 0

disable: DC 25 Arcana check or DC 25 Occultism check to close of a planar breach, DC 21 Athletics check to snap one of the branches, or 4th-rank Planar Tether to seal of a breach. For each branch snapped or breach sealed, remove one action from the Heart's routine. Once the Heart reaches 0 actions in its routine, it is disabled.
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (3 actions) The Heart spends all of its actions making thorny vine Strikes against different creatures. The Heart doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

items.name: Crushing Horror
items.text:
Trigger The Heart breaks its planar bonds

---
Effect Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 22 Will save save. The Heart then rolls initiative.

---
Success The creature shrugs of the infuence of the Heart.

Failure The creature takes 3d8 mental damage and is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes 6d8 mental damage and is Frightened 2. The creature can't reduce its frightened value below 1 for 1 minute.

items.name: Anguish
items.text: The vine squeezes and overwhelms the creature with fear. The target takes 4d4 mental damage with a DC 24 basic Will save save. On a critical failure, the creature is also Frightened 1 and can't reduce its frightened value below 1 for 1 minute.

text: Within this mockery of a tree is a large, beating growth pushing grotesque branches through jagged planar fssures.
